*Bracelets of Submission: Wonder Woman's indestructible bracelets that were forged from the remnants of the Aegis Shield wielded by Zeus. They can harmlessly deflect virtually any projectile or attack, even defending against the mighty Omega Beams of Darkseid. When crossed, Wonder Woman can create a hemispherical barrier positioned in front of her to defend against attacks that she would not be able to deflect, such as large explosions. In addition, Diana can channel Zeus' lightning through them to strike her foes by striking the bracelets together. *Lasso of Truth: Diana's most famous and iconic weapon, it is a magical lasso forged and blessed by the gods. to be completely indestructible even to entities as powerful as Superman. In addition, Hestia blessed it with the fires of her hearth so that all caught in its clutches will be forced to tell the truth, no matter how much they resist questioning. The Lasso has also been known to be able to restore the memories of others, hypnotize others, dispel illusions, and offer a measure of protection against magical attacks for those within its radius. The lasso seems to be able to alter its length according to Diana's wishes and she can also use it as a whip if necessary. *Tiara of Athena: A crown given to the Amazons by the goddess of wisdom, it enhances Diana's senses and strengthens her mind against mental attacks. In addition, it can be used as a boomerang-like projectile sharp enough to slice the throat of Superman and temporarily incapacitate him.

Genius (Blessed by the goddess Athena to be skilled in every discipline, Diana is the finest warrior the Amazons have ever produced, being trained in the use of every weapon known to man as well as all of the exotic combat styles known to the Amazons. She has proven herself time and again to be among the greatest hand-to-hand combatants in the world, frequently outmatching the few beings that exceed her in might through sheer skill, having bested immortals in battle and can take on multiple members of the Justice League at once. She is also gifted with incredible insight and empathy, allowing her to understand her opponents and their movements as well as their intentions with ease. Her blessings have also granted her a natural gift for leadership, diplomacy, and strategy, being the ambassador of Themiscyra and frequently matching wits with that of Batman and other intellectuals of the DC Universe, possessing a particularly profound knowledge of the occult and mythology.)

Wonder Woman is weak to sharp objects such as spears, swords, bullets, etc., she can only use the Godwave for a few minutes or she will go insane Notable Attacks/Techniques: *Godwave: With focused meditation and prayer, Diana can channel the power of the Godwave, one of the primordial cosmic forces of the DC Universe, greatly amplifying all of her abilities and shrouding her in a powerful divine aura. However, overuse of this ability will eventually render her insane, forcing her to use this sparingly. tier.text: , up to at least , likely higher with magic

attack_potency.text: Building level (Cut off the head of one vampire then fought and killed some more, with vampires being strong enough to throw cars. Those vampires had their strength increased by Cain, and were able to restrain and threaten Batgirl albeit in a group. Should be comparable to his durability), up to at least Solar System level (Hurt I, Vampire, who stomped Apollo. Madame Xanadu does not have the power to contrast John's magic. Was considered to be among the five magicians on Earth who could contribute to a powerful spell meant to save the Earth, implying him to be at least somewhat comparable to Dr. Fate and Zatanna, though he is certainly weaker than either of them.Martian Manhunter Vol 4 11 Hurt Frankenstein and Black Orchid with a magic attack), possibly higher (Knows a spell "powerful enough to kill a god", who he believed might stop The Upside-Down Man, though it ultimately failed to scratch him. Still, it should be much stronger than any other attack of hisJustice League Dark Vol 2 3) with magic

speed.text: Possibly Peak Human running speed (Could briefly outrun some magic monkeys, with most real life monkeys being able to run at 30 km/h or faster), at least Supersonic+, possibly Hypersonic+ combat speed (Could fight a group of vampires that managed to overpower and surprise Batgirl), up to Massively FTL+ attack speed (Can tag Frankenstein and I, Vampire with his spells)

durability.text: Building level (Comparable to his striking strength. Survived an attack that smashed him against a wallJustice League Dark Vol 1 29), up to Solar System level with forcefields and seals

stamina.text: Superhuman. Walked back to his home and performed a spell after being brutally beaten and stabbed in the stomach.Justice League Dark Vol 1 2 Performed a 12-hour ritual summoning that involved much self-harm. Could fight after being dazed by both medical and magical means. Withstood a night of hellish torture without breaking a sweat.Constantine: The Hellblazer Vol 1 9 Could calmly hold a conversation and weasel his way out of a dangerous situation after being shot with an arrow through the shoulder and beaten up by a small gang of criminals.The Hellblazer Vol 1 20The Hellblazer Vol 1 21

range.text: Standard Melee Range, Extended Melee Range with weapons, Varies, up to Multiversal+ with magic (Has been able to tap into The Green. However, note that John's spells greatly vary in range, with him once struggling to cover New York City with a single spell)

intelligence.text: At least Genius, possibly Extraordinary Genius. John Constantine is very knowledgeable in ancient and occult matters,Constantine Vol 1 1 such as obscure monsters from various mythologies, not to speak of the many, many spells he is able to use and defuse.The Hellblazer Vol 1 15 Learned how to use Zatanna's backwards magic just by having heard her mumble it in her sleep,Justice League Dark Vol 1 3 while she had to endure years of incredibly rigid training to master it. John's sheer magic skill is such that he could threaten even powerhouses such as The Spectre or Swamp Thing. Was the only one among the Justice League Dark to figure out how to seal June Moon and the Enchantress together and that Madame Xanadu was the one to split them in the first place. Despite the (mutual) hatred that almost everyone in the Justice League Dark has shown towards Constantine, he has proven to be a very good leader, coming up with clever plans and being able to adapt them on the spot.Trinity of Sin: Pandora Vol 1 7Justice League Dark Vol 1 9 Knows all about Shazam's origin and powers.Justice League Dark Vol 1 22 Mostly correctly guessed that The Phantom Stranger was only imitating human feelings. Defeated all the Justice League Dark except Zatanna at once while drunk. Came up with a plan to turn a madman's obsession with William Blake against him. As better detailed in his Social Influencing section in Powers & Abilities, John Constantine is known as the World's Greatest Con Man for a reason, with him having shown the ability to adapt his incredible talking and planning skills to basically any situation, to the point that one could say that despite his wealth of magical knowledge, John's best weapon is his cunning. Standard Tactics: Constantine is typically not a fighter. If possible, he will retreat from a fight to find help or a better strategy. If that is impossible, he is a dirty fighter, sometimes completely forgoing flashy magic spells for more subtle and sneaky tactics if it fits the situation. Other times, he will seek to end the fight as quickly as possible, resorting to techniques that ignore durability in favor of incapacitating or even killing the enemy in some other way.

Other times, he will seek to end the fight as quickly as possible, resorting to techniques that ignore durability in favor of incapacitating or even killing the enemy in some other way.

Suffers from lung cancer now that his Demon Blood has been removed. Other times, he will seek to end the fight as quickly as possible, resorting to techniques that ignore durability in favor of incapacitating or even killing the enemy in some other way.

Suffers from lung cancer now that his Demon Blood has been removed. Thanks to the Omega energies he gained incredible power and a wide array of abilities. * Omega Beams: Darkseid's signature technique involves firing a thin, red energy beam from each eye. These beams, also known as "Finder Beams", are extremely fast and home in on their target, passing through physical barriers if needed. Once contact is made, they can either erase the target from existence, a technique called the total wipeout, or transport them through time and space according to Darkseid's will. He can also use them to recreate dead beings, or paralyze his target while probing their weakness. * Omega Sanction: Also known as the Life Trap, the Omega Sanction can take two completely different forms depending on Darkseid's intent. The first simply sends his target back in time, forcing them to live out their life in the past. The second, stated by Grant Morrison to happen when Darkseid decides on being crueler than normal, was only displayed by Godhead Darkseid. It traps the victim in a never-ending series of horrible realities that force them to live out worse and worse lives, until their soul breaks. * Energy Absorption: Darkseid is an immensely powerful energy absorber, capable of completely draining the energies of powerful beings like Mordru and all of Sorcerers' World to help restore his own power. His absorption is so powerful that he ordered his servants to get away from him lest they be killed, and some of his servants were capable of taking on Pre-Crisis Kryptonians and Daxamites. * Energy Shockwaves: Darkseid can create shockwaves of energy by raising his hands. * Spacetime Warping: Darkseid can generate a gravitational pull so intense that space twists and time is pulled, so that those inside live days between seconds. * Boom Tubes: Darkseid can summon boom tubes at will, as well as control the paths of others' boom tubes. They automatically adjust the size of their user to be suitable for their destination, which is why Darkseid appears human-sized rather than star-sized when travelling to the mortal universe. * Telepathy: Darkseid has incredibly powerful telepathic abilities. He can forcefully drain information out of his target's mind as well as control others with his will. While in a weakened state during the Great Darkness Saga, he controlled three billion Daxamites at once. He was able to force his mind into others' from across dimensional gaps. * Avatars: Darkseid can create duplicate bodies from portions of his energy that can function autonomously. They are significantly weaker than his real body but otherwise seem to retain his intellect and abilities. As all instances of Darkseid seen in lower-dimensional realms are infinitesimally small parts of Darkseid's true being, it stands to reason that Godhead Darkseid possesses all of the abilities demonstrated by them but to a much greater degree. Furthermore, he also possessed the Anti-Life Equation, using it to dominate much of Earth's populace in the moments before everything would be destroyed. * Omega Beams: A single use of the Omega Beams, used when Darkseid was dying and possessing the body of a cancer-ridden Dan Turpin, contained enough energy to destroy time itself. * Omega Sanction: The version of the Sanction used by the True Darkseid is infinitely more powerful and cruel than the Sanction demonstrated by his Pre-Flashpoint emanation. Rather than displacing its target through time it traps them in a never-ending succession of dark realities that inflict endless suffering upon the prisoner. * Possession: Darkseid can incarnate in the lower-dimensional mortal universe by possessing the body of a mortal. However, to truly incarnate he needs to corrupt the body of a good soul, which was why his first attempt at incarnating via a mob boss was a failure. * Anti-Life Equation: Using the Anti-Life Equation, Darkseid was able to assume total control over everyone who had been exposed to the broadcasted equation, effectively gaining three billion new bodies at once. The victims were completely subsumed by Darkseid's will, speaking with his voice and moving according to his desire.

Notable Attacks/Techniques: * Omega Effect: Uxas was reborn as Darkseid when he absorbed the full power of the Omega Effect from the Infinity Pit. Thanks to the Omega energies he gained incredible power and a wide array of abilities. * Omega Beams: Darkseid's signature technique involves firing a thin, red energy beam from each eye. These beams, also known as "Finder Beams", are extremely fast and home in on their target, passing through physical barriers if needed. Once contact is made, they can either erase the target from existence, a technique called the total wipeout, or transport them through time and space according to Darkseid's will. He can also use them to recreate dead beings, or paralyze his target while probing their weakness. * Omega Sanction: Also known as the Life Trap, the Omega Sanction can take two completely different forms depending on Darkseid's intent. The first simply sends his target back in time, forcing them to live out their life in the past. The second, stated by Grant Morrison to happen when Darkseid decides on being crueler than normal, was only displayed by Godhead Darkseid. It traps the victim in a never-ending series of horrible realities that force them to live out worse and worse lives, until their soul breaks. * Energy Absorption: Darkseid is an immensely powerful energy absorber, capable of completely draining the energies of powerful beings like Mordru and all of Sorcerers' World to help restore his own power. His absorption is so powerful that he ordered his servants to get away from him lest they be killed, and some of his servants were capable of taking on Pre-Crisis Kryptonians and Daxamites. * Energy Shockwaves: Darkseid can create shockwaves of energy by raising his hands. * Spacetime Warping: Darkseid can generate a gravitational pull so intense that space twists and time is pulled, so that those inside live days between seconds. * Boom Tubes: Darkseid can summon boom tubes at will, as well as control the paths of others' boom tubes. These portals can transport their user throughout space and between dimensions. They automatically adjust the size of their user to be suitable for their destination, which is why Darkseid appears human-sized rather than star-sized when travelling to the mortal universe. * Telepathy: Darkseid has incredibly powerful telepathic abilities. He can forcefully drain information out of his target's mind as well as control others with his will. While in a weakened state during the Great Darkness Saga, he controlled three billion Daxamites at once. He was able to force his mind into others' from across dimensional gaps. * Avatars: Darkseid can create duplicate bodies from portions of his energy that can function autonomously. They are significantly weaker than his real body but otherwise seem to retain his intellect and abilities. As all instances of Darkseid seen in lower-dimensional realms are infinitesimally small parts of Darkseid's true being, it stands to reason that Godhead Darkseid possesses all of the abilities demonstrated by them but to a much greater degree. Furthermore, he also possessed the Anti-Life Equation, using it to dominate much of Earth's populace in the moments before everything would be destroyed. * Omega Beams: A single use of the Omega Beams, used when Darkseid was dying and possessing the body of a cancer-ridden Dan Turpin, contained enough energy to destroy time itself. * Omega Sanction: The version of the Sanction used by the True Darkseid is infinitely more powerful and cruel than the Sanction demonstrated by his Pre-Flashpoint emanation. Rather than displacing its target through time it traps them in a never-ending succession of dark realities that inflict endless suffering upon the prisoner. * Possession: Darkseid can incarnate in the lower-dimensional mortal universe by possessing the body of a mortal. However, to truly incarnate he needs to corrupt the body of a good soul, which was why his first attempt at incarnating via a mob boss was a failure. * Anti-Life Equation: Using the Anti-Life Equation, Darkseid was able to assume total control over everyone who had been exposed to the broadcasted equation, effectively gaining three billion new bodies at once. The victims were completely subsumed by Darkseid's will, speaking with his voice and moving according to his desire.

Extraordinary Genius (He has countless years of experience in strategy, military tactics, governing, and scientific pursuit. He easily convinced a Martian Survivor to be his Fury of Death and birth his Deathspawn, Manipulated the Old Gods into a fatal war to gain power, created the Post Flashpoint version of Boomtubes to follow Kaiyo across realities, and is implied to have created Apokolips itself with much of its technology.

None (varies depending on the circumstances). Darkseid usually creates technology for the purpose at hand - for example, he created a capture device that stole a piece of the Anti-Life Entity's power. Due to his ability to summon boom tubes at will, Darkseid has instant access to all of Apokolips' technology and armies, should he need them. Optional

Darkseid is vulnerable to radion, a lethal substance to New Gods. It should be noted, however, that powerful New Gods like Kalibak are able to easily survive normal radion shots. When Darkseid was shot and weakened by the radion bullet he was already dying. In order to fully incarnate in a lower dimension by possessing a human body, a noble soul must be corrupted, otherwise the process is not fully successful. Feats: * Knocked out Superman with a single blast of Omega Beams * Destroyed world after world, killing Supermen throughout the multiverse * Fought against Earth-2 Alan Scott, who had absorbed every Parliament in addition to the Green and unlocked the "potential of the multiverse...the true power of the green" * [After power-up] Fought against the Anti-Monitor, which threatened to unravel history * [After being reborn] Killed Zeus by absorbing all his life force, in order to age himself back to adulthood Notable Attacks/Techniques: Omega Effect: The Post-Flashpoint emanation of Darkseid gained his Omega powers by absorbing the energies of dead Old Gods, although that origin story is somewhat contradicted by the one Highfather tells. The Omega Effect is said to be infinite, and granted Darkseid a variety of powerful abilities. * Omega Beams: Darkseid can fire extremely fast, homing beams of energy from his eyes. It is important to note that the Post-Flashpoint emanation of Darkseid has not demonstrated the same versatility with Omega Beams that the Pre-Flashpoint emanation did, and they seem to simply be powerful energy attacks. * Energy Shockwaves: Darkseid can create shockwaves of energy by raising his hands. * Spacetime Warping: Darkseid can generate a gravitational pull so intense that space twists and time is pulled, so that those inside live days between seconds. Boom Tubes: Darkseid can activate boom tubes at any time, which allow him to teleport through space and across dimensions. Telepathy: Darkseid is able to force his mind into others' from across dimensional gaps. Notable Attacks/Techniques: * Omega Effect: Uxas was reborn as Darkseid when he absorbed the full power of the Omega Effect from the Infinity Pit. Thanks to the Omega energies he gained incredible power and a wide array of abilities. * Omega Beams: Darkseid's signature technique involves firing a thin, red energy beam from each eye. These beams, also known as "Finder Beams", are extremely fast and home in on their target, passing through physical barriers if needed. Once contact is made, they can either erase the target from existence, a technique called the total wipeout, or transport them through time and space according to Darkseid's will. He can also use them to recreate dead beings, or paralyze his target while probing their weakness. * Omega Sanction: Also known as the Life Trap, the Omega Sanction can take two completely different forms depending on Darkseid's intent. The first simply sends his target back in time, forcing them to live out their life in the past. The second, stated by Grant Morrison to happen when Darkseid decides on being crueler than normal, was only displayed by Godhead Darkseid. It traps the victim in a never-ending series of horrible realities that force them to live out worse and worse lives, until their soul breaks. * Energy Absorption: Darkseid is an immensely powerful energy absorber, capable of completely draining the energies of powerful beings like Mordru and all of Sorcerers' World to help restore his own power. His absorption is so powerful that he ordered his servants to get away from him lest they be killed, and some of his servants were capable of taking on Pre-Crisis Kryptonians and Daxamites. * Energy Shockwaves: Darkseid can create shockwaves of energy by raising his hands. * Spacetime Warping: Darkseid can generate a gravitational pull so intense that space twists and time is pulled, so that those inside live days between seconds. * Boom Tubes: Darkseid can summon boom tubes at will, as well as control the paths of others' boom tubes. These portals can transport their user throughout space and between dimensions. They automatically adjust the size of their user to be suitable for their destination, which is why Darkseid appears human-sized rather than star-sized when travelling to the mortal universe. * Telepathy: Darkseid has incredibly powerful telepathic abilities. He can forcefully drain information out of his target's mind as well as control others with his will. While in a weakened state during the Great Darkness Saga, he controlled three billion Daxamites at once. He was able to force his mind into others' from across dimensional gaps. * Avatars: Darkseid can create duplicate bodies from portions of his energy that can function autonomously. They are significantly weaker than his real body but otherwise seem to retain his intellect and abilities. As all instances of Darkseid seen in lower-dimensional realms are infinitesimally small parts of Darkseid's true being, it stands to reason that Godhead Darkseid possesses all of the abilities demonstrated by them but to a much greater degree. Furthermore, he also possessed the Anti-Life Equation, using it to dominate much of Earth's populace in the moments before everything would be destroyed. * Omega Beams: A single use of the Omega Beams, used when Darkseid was dying and possessing the body of a cancer-ridden Dan Turpin, contained enough energy to destroy time itself. * Omega Sanction: The version of the Sanction used by the True Darkseid is infinitely more powerful and cruel than the Sanction demonstrated by his Pre-Flashpoint emanation. Rather than displacing its target through time it traps them in a never-ending succession of dark realities that inflict endless suffering upon the prisoner. * Possession: Darkseid can incarnate in the lower-dimensional mortal universe by possessing the body of a mortal. However, to truly incarnate he needs to corrupt the body of a good soul, which was why his first attempt at incarnating via a mob boss was a failure. * Anti-Life Equation: Using the Anti-Life Equation, Darkseid was able to assume total control over everyone who had been exposed to the broadcasted equation, effectively gaining three billion new bodies at once. The victims were completely subsumed by Darkseid's will, speaking with his voice and moving according to his desire.

Notable Attacks/Techniques: * Omega Effect: Uxas was reborn as Darkseid when he absorbed the full power of the Omega Effect from the Infinity Pit. Thanks to the Omega energies he gained incredible power and a wide array of abilities. * Omega Beams: Darkseid's signature technique involves firing a thin, red energy beam from each eye. These beams, also known as "Finder Beams", are extremely fast and home in on their target, passing through physical barriers if needed. Once contact is made, they can either erase the target from existence, a technique called the total wipeout, or transport them through time and space according to Darkseid's will. He can also use them to recreate dead beings, or paralyze his target while probing their weakness. * Omega Sanction: Also known as the Life Trap, the Omega Sanction can take two completely different forms depending on Darkseid's intent. The first simply sends his target back in time, forcing them to live out their life in the past. The second, stated by Grant Morrison to happen when Darkseid decides on being crueler than normal, was only displayed by Godhead Darkseid. It traps the victim in a never-ending series of horrible realities that force them to live out worse and worse lives, until their soul breaks. * Energy Absorption: Darkseid is an immensely powerful energy absorber, capable of completely draining the energies of powerful beings like Mordru and all of Sorcerers' World to help restore his own power. His absorption is so powerful that he ordered his servants to get away from him lest they be killed, and some of his servants were capable of taking on Pre-Crisis Kryptonians and Daxamites. * Energy Shockwaves: Darkseid can create shockwaves of energy by raising his hands. * Spacetime Warping: Darkseid can generate a gravitational pull so intense that space twists and time is pulled, so that those inside live days between seconds. * Boom Tubes: Darkseid can summon boom tubes at will, as well as control the paths of others' boom tubes. These portals can transport their user throughout space and between dimensions. They automatically adjust the size of their user to be suitable for their destination, which is why Darkseid appears human-sized rather than star-sized when travelling to the mortal universe. * Telepathy: Darkseid has incredibly powerful telepathic abilities. He can forcefully drain information out of his target's mind as well as control others with his will. While in a weakened state during the Great Darkness Saga, he controlled three billion Daxamites at once. He was able to force his mind into others' from across dimensional gaps. * Avatars: Darkseid can create duplicate bodies from portions of his energy that can function autonomously. They are significantly weaker than his real body but otherwise seem to retain his intellect and abilities. As all instances of Darkseid seen in lower-dimensional realms are infinitesimally small parts of Darkseid's true being, it stands to reason that Godhead Darkseid possesses all of the abilities demonstrated by them but to a much greater degree. Furthermore, he also possessed the Anti-Life Equation, using it to dominate much of Earth's populace in the moments before everything would be destroyed. * Omega Beams: A single use of the Omega Beams, used when Darkseid was dying and possessing the body of a cancer-ridden Dan Turpin, contained enough energy to destroy time itself. * Omega Sanction: The version of the Sanction used by the True Darkseid is infinitely more powerful and cruel than the Sanction demonstrated by his Pre-Flashpoint emanation. Rather than displacing its target through time it traps them in a never-ending succession of dark realities that inflict endless suffering upon the prisoner. * Possession: Darkseid can incarnate in the lower-dimensional mortal universe by possessing the body of a mortal. However, to truly incarnate he needs to corrupt the body of a good soul, which was why his first attempt at incarnating via a mob boss was a failure. * Anti-Life Equation: Using the Anti-Life Equation, Darkseid was able to assume total control over everyone who had been exposed to the broadcasted equation, effectively gaining three billion new bodies at once. The victims were completely subsumed by Darkseid's will, speaking with his voice and moving according to his desire.

They automatically adjust the size of their user to be suitable for their destination, which is why Darkseid appears human-sized rather than star-sized when travelling to the mortal universe. * Telepathy: Darkseid has incredibly powerful telepathic abilities. He can forcefully drain information out of his target's mind as well as control others with his will. While in a weakened state during the Great Darkness Saga, he controlled three billion Daxamites at once. He was able to force his mind into others' from across dimensional gaps. * Avatars: Darkseid can create duplicate bodies from portions of his energy that can function autonomously. They are significantly weaker than his real body but otherwise seem to retain his intellect and abilities. As all instances of Darkseid seen in lower-dimensional realms are infinitesimally small parts of Darkseid's true being, it stands to reason that Godhead Darkseid possesses all of the abilities demonstrated by them but to a much greater degree. Furthermore, he also possessed the Anti-Life Equation, using it to dominate much of Earth's populace in the moments before everything would be destroyed. * Omega Beams: A single use of the Omega Beams, used when Darkseid was dying and possessing the body of a cancer-ridden Dan Turpin, contained enough energy to destroy time itself. * Omega Sanction: The version of the Sanction used by the True Darkseid is infinitely more powerful and cruel than the Sanction demonstrated by his Pre-Flashpoint emanation. Rather than displacing its target through time it traps them in a never-ending succession of dark realities that inflict endless suffering upon the prisoner. * Possession: Darkseid can incarnate in the lower-dimensional mortal universe by possessing the body of a mortal. However, to truly incarnate he needs to corrupt the body of a good soul, which was why his first attempt at incarnating via a mob boss was a failure. * Anti-Life Equation: Using the Anti-Life Equation, Darkseid was able to assume total control over everyone who had been exposed to the broadcasted equation, effectively gaining three billion new bodies at once. The victims were completely subsumed by Darkseid's will, speaking with his voice and moving according to his desire.

Notable Attacks/Techniques: * Omega Effect: Uxas was reborn as Darkseid when he absorbed the full power of the Omega Effect from the Infinity Pit. Thanks to the Omega energies he gained incredible power and a wide array of abilities. * Omega Beams: Darkseid's signature technique involves firing a thin, red energy beam from each eye. These beams, also known as "Finder Beams", are extremely fast and home in on their target, passing through physical barriers if needed. Once contact is made, they can either erase the target from existence, a technique called the total wipeout, or transport them through time and space according to Darkseid's will. He can also use them to recreate dead beings, or paralyze his target while probing their weakness. * Omega Sanction: Also known as the Life Trap, the Omega Sanction can take two completely different forms depending on Darkseid's intent. The first simply sends his target back in time, forcing them to live out their life in the past. The second, stated by Grant Morrison to happen when Darkseid decides on being crueler than normal, was only displayed by Godhead Darkseid. It traps the victim in a never-ending series of horrible realities that force them to live out worse and worse lives, until their soul breaks. * Energy Absorption: Darkseid is an immensely powerful energy absorber, capable of completely draining the energies of powerful beings like Mordru and all of Sorcerers' World to help restore his own power. Notable Attacks/Techniques: * Omega Effect: Uxas was reborn as Darkseid when he absorbed the full power of the Omega Effect from the Infinity Pit. Thanks to the Omega energies he gained incredible power and a wide array of abilities. * Omega Beams: Darkseid's signature technique involves firing a thin, red energy beam from each eye. These beams, also known as "Finder Beams", are extremely fast and home in on their target, passing through physical barriers if needed. Once contact is made, they can either erase the target from existence, a technique called the total wipeout, or transport them through time and space according to Darkseid's will. He can also use them to recreate dead beings, or paralyze his target while probing their weakness. * Omega Sanction: Also known as the Life Trap, the Omega Sanction can take two completely different forms depending on Darkseid's intent. The first simply sends his target back in time, forcing them to live out their life in the past. The second, stated by Grant Morrison to happen when Darkseid decides on being crueler than normal, was only displayed by Godhead Darkseid. It traps the victim in a never-ending series of horrible realities that force them to live out worse and worse lives, until their soul breaks. * Energy Absorption: Darkseid is an immensely powerful energy absorber, capable of completely draining the energies of powerful beings like Mordru and all of Sorcerers' World to help restore his own power. His absorption is so powerful that he ordered his servants to get away from him lest they be killed, and some of his servants were capable of taking on Pre-Crisis Kryptonians and Daxamites. * Energy Shockwaves: Darkseid can create shockwaves of energy by raising his hands. * Spacetime Warping: Darkseid can generate a gravitational pull so intense that space twists and time is pulled, so that those inside live days between seconds. * Boom Tubes: Darkseid can summon boom tubes at will, as well as control the paths of others' boom tubes. These portals can transport their user throughout space and between dimensions. They automatically adjust the size of their user to be suitable for their destination, which is why Darkseid appears human-sized rather than star-sized when travelling to the mortal universe. * Telepathy: Darkseid has incredibly powerful telepathic abilities. He can forcefully drain information out of his target's mind as well as control others with his will. While in a weakened state during the Great Darkness Saga, he controlled three billion Daxamites at once. He was able to force his mind into others' from across dimensional gaps. * Avatars: Darkseid can create duplicate bodies from portions of his energy that can function autonomously. They are significantly weaker than his real body but otherwise seem to retain his intellect and abilities. As all instances of Darkseid seen in lower-dimensional realms are infinitesimally small parts of Darkseid's true being, it stands to reason that Godhead Darkseid possesses all of the abilities demonstrated by them but to a much greater degree. Furthermore, he also possessed the Anti-Life Equation, using it to dominate much of Earth's populace in the moments before everything would be destroyed. * Omega Beams: A single use of the Omega Beams, used when Darkseid was dying and possessing the body of a cancer-ridden Dan Turpin, contained enough energy to destroy time itself. * Omega Sanction: The version of the Sanction used by the True Darkseid is infinitely more powerful and cruel than the Sanction demonstrated by his Pre-Flashpoint emanation. Rather than displacing its target through time it traps them in a never-ending succession of dark realities that inflict endless suffering upon the prisoner. * Possession: Darkseid can incarnate in the lower-dimensional mortal universe by possessing the body of a mortal. However, to truly incarnate he needs to corrupt the body of a good soul, which was why his first attempt at incarnating via a mob boss was a failure. * Anti-Life Equation: Using the Anti-Life Equation, Darkseid was able to assume total control over everyone who had been exposed to the broadcasted equation, effectively gaining three billion new bodies at once. The victims were completely subsumed by Darkseid's will, speaking with his voice and moving according to his desire.

Notable Attacks/Techniques: * Omega Effect: Uxas was reborn as Darkseid when he absorbed the full power of the Omega Effect from the Infinity Pit. Thanks to the Omega energies he gained incredible power and a wide array of abilities. * Omega Beams: Darkseid's signature technique involves firing a thin, red energy beam from each eye. These beams, also known as "Finder Beams", are extremely fast and home in on their target, passing through physical barriers if needed. Once contact is made, they can either erase the target from existence, a technique called the total wipeout, or transport them through time and space according to Darkseid's will. He can also use them to recreate dead beings, or paralyze his target while probing their weakness. * Omega Sanction: Also known as the Life Trap, the Omega Sanction can take two completely different forms depending on Darkseid's intent. The first simply sends his target back in time, forcing them to live out their life in the past. The second, stated by Grant Morrison to happen when Darkseid decides on being crueler than normal, was only displayed by Godhead Darkseid. It traps the victim in a never-ending series of horrible realities that force them to live out worse and worse lives, until their soul breaks. * Energy Absorption: Darkseid is an immensely powerful energy absorber, capable of completely draining the energies of powerful beings like Mordru and all of Sorcerers' World to help restore his own power. His absorption is so powerful that he ordered his servants to get away from him lest they be killed, and some of his servants were capable of taking on Pre-Crisis Kryptonians and Daxamites. * Energy Shockwaves: Darkseid can create shockwaves of energy by raising his hands. * Spacetime Warping: Darkseid can generate a gravitational pull so intense that space twists and time is pulled, so that those inside live days between seconds. * Boom Tubes: Darkseid can summon boom tubes at will, as well as control the paths of others' boom tubes. These portals can transport their user throughout space and between dimensions. They automatically adjust the size of their user to be suitable for their destination, which is why Darkseid appears human-sized rather than star-sized when travelling to the mortal universe. * Telepathy: Darkseid has incredibly powerful telepathic abilities. He can forcefully drain information out of his target's mind as well as control others with his will. While in a weakened state during the Great Darkness Saga, he controlled three billion Daxamites at once. He was able to force his mind into others' from across dimensional gaps. * Avatars: Darkseid can create duplicate bodies from portions of his energy that can function autonomously. They are significantly weaker than his real body but otherwise seem to retain his intellect and abilities. As all instances of Darkseid seen in lower-dimensional realms are infinitesimally small parts of Darkseid's true being, it stands to reason that Godhead Darkseid possesses all of the abilities demonstrated by them but to a much greater degree. Furthermore, he also possessed the Anti-Life Equation, using it to dominate much of Earth's populace in the moments before everything would be destroyed. * Omega Beams: A single use of the Omega Beams, used when Darkseid was dying and possessing the body of a cancer-ridden Dan Turpin, contained enough energy to destroy time itself. * Omega Sanction: The version of the Sanction used by the True Darkseid is infinitely more powerful and cruel than the Sanction demonstrated by his Pre-Flashpoint emanation. Rather than displacing its target through time it traps them in a never-ending succession of dark realities that inflict endless suffering upon the prisoner. * Possession: Darkseid can incarnate in the lower-dimensional mortal universe by possessing the body of a mortal. However, to truly incarnate he needs to corrupt the body of a good soul, which was why his first attempt at incarnating via a mob boss was a failure. * Anti-Life Equation: Using the Anti-Life Equation, Darkseid was able to assume total control over everyone who had been exposed to the broadcasted equation, effectively gaining three billion new bodies at once. The victims were completely subsumed by Darkseid's will, speaking with his voice and moving according to his desire.

He regularly draws chess matches against Eclipso, a cosmic entity and former embodiment of God's Wrath, and built a spaceship larger than the state of New York. Darkseid is responsible for some of the most advanced scientific breakthroughs in the DCU, creating technology capable of penetrating the Source, accessing the realm of Anti-Life, stealing part of the Anti-Life Entity's power, combining and manipulating fragments of the Anti-Life Equation, and turning Mars into a copy of Apokolips. His mind is also extremely adaptable, capable of comprehending the warped dimension of Olympus without any effort, while Superman was completely bewildered by it. The Pre-Flashpoint emanation of Darkseid even remembers events from erased timelines)

None (varies depending on the circumstances). Darkseid usually creates technology for the purpose at hand - for example, he created a capture device that stole a piece of the Anti-Life Entity's power. Due to his ability to summon boom tubes at will, Darkseid has instant access to all of Apokolips' technology and armies, should he need them | The Anti-Life Equation

Darkseid is vulnerable to radion, a lethal substance to New GodsIt should be noted, however, that powerful New Gods like Kalibak are able to easily survive normal radion shots. When Darkseid was shot and weakened by the radion bullet he was already dying. Moreover, in order to fully incarnate in a lower plane of reality by possessing a human body, a noble soul must be corrupted, otherwise the process is not fully successful. He can also use them to recreate dead beings, or paralyze his target while probing their weakness. * Omega Sanction: Also known as the Life Trap, the Omega Sanction can take two completely different forms depending on Darkseid's intent. Likewise, characters like Superman are grown to the scale of the New Gods when they enter Apokolips or New Genesis. Irrelevant The House of Mystery's origins are unknown, yet it appears to exist simultaneously in both The Dreaming and Earth, near to a graveyard. The House appears to be sentient and serves as a repository for stories, usually extremely awful ones. Cain has cared after the House for endless years, much as his brother Abel looks for the House of Secrets. Cain went absent briefly a few years ago, and the House nominated Elvira as its new caretaker until he returned; the House appears to require a caretaker, despite the fact that it is perfectly capable of looking after itself, and indeed of totally rebuilding itself at will.Elvira's House of Mystery #1 Cain eventually confessed that he had been lurking inside the House all along, and Elvira went on to host horror stories elsewhere.Elvira's House of Mystery #11 Shortly later, Morpheus, the Lord of the Dreaming, returned to his domain after over a century in jail and staggered to the House of Mystery's door, where Cain and Abel nursed him to health. Following Morpheus' return, the House focused mostly on the Dreaming, where Cain frequently entertained other supernatural storytellers.Sandman (Volume 2) #2 More recently, the House has vanished from its usual location(s) and transformed into a coaching inn in an extradimensional realm; Cain spent several months searching for it. Batman is also a master of disguise, being capable of disguising himself as people of different races and ages. Batman is known for his ability to be completely unnoticed and unseen through these methods. *Senses: Batman has honed his senses to perfection, allowing him to achieve analysis most others cannot. This includes smelling chemical changes and pheromones in order to smell his foe’s emotion, hearing normally unnoticed sounds in Gotham, and seeing things far too far away for a normal eye to see. *Preparation: Batman is a master of using resources and time in order to prepare himself for any objective. While Batman is a nearly unrivaled scientific genius, the real danger comes from his ability to predict situations that may arise and plan for nearly any future conflict. Even before a situation shows the possibility of occurring, Batman has likely already planned for it. For example, Batman has planned methods to kill every one of his allies individually should the need arise, prepared a extra mind just in case he needed it, and observed the majority of what can be considered human culture, from song references to obscure shows, in order to be ready for any threat, among many other things. Genius (Slade is a great strategist and tactician. Always calculating his opponents' moves beforehand; he even singlehandedly defeated a JLA roster that lacked the "Big Three". He has been compared to Batman in terms of tactical methods. Even against metahumans, he has proven more than a match for them all at once with time to prepare. Roy Harper once claimed the Slade was, "The world's greatest tactician." Using his superior problem-solving skills, Deathstroke can work out a battle ahead of time for many possibilities and predict enemy movements and tactics after the battle has engaged by recalling and utilizing memorized mannerisms acquired through past experience on a moment's notice.)

He is half blind due to having his right eye shot out before he received his healing factor. Various blades, firearms and explosives. *The Deathstroke: It is an antique war blade that Slade won in a poker game. It was later re-cast in Promethium that's capable of absorbing an enormous amount of any kind of energy. *Titanium Staff: His titanium staff can fire powerful energy blasts. Its mode can be switched from "stun to kill", and it can be split into two to produce ultrasonics. Optional

Extraordinary Genius (Despite all of his enhanced physical attributes and healing, Slade's real superpower is his intellect. His strategic genius is arguably superior to Batman. Outsmarted Batman on multiple occasions. Easily saw through a Teen Titan's trap that uses Djinn's magic and had help from Jericho. Batman doesn't even try to understand his real motives. Figured out the true person that sent out Damian Wayne's fake blood test results, while even Batman couldn't. Has eidetic memory, remembered a guy he saw for three seconds a decade ago. Nonchalantly figured out Batman's identity and sneaked up on him, putting a gun to his face. Managed to tap into the Speed Force to gain superspeed, but later lost it after gaining a higher consciousness. Deathstroke enhancements also evolved his brain, granting him an enhanced mental capacity, causing his mind to operate at peak efficiency, nine times beyond that of a normal man.Batman (Volume 3) #86, p. 11 He describes his mind as a super-computer designed to process information and break it down with superior tactical and strategic thought.Deathstroke (Volume 2) #9, p. 7)

He is half blind due to having his right eye shot out before he received his healing factor. Due to him having an Ikon Suit prototype, his left arm isn't fully covered. Irrelevant The House of Mystery's origins are unknown, yet it appears to exist simultaneously in both The Dreaming and Earth, near to a graveyard. The House appears to be sentient and serves as a repository for stories, usually extremely awful ones. Cain has cared after the House for endless years, much as his brother Abel looks for the House of Secrets. Cain went absent briefly a few years ago, and the House nominated Elvira as its new caretaker until he returned; the House appears to require a caretaker, despite the fact that it is perfectly capable of looking after itself, and indeed of totally rebuilding itself at will.Elvira's House of Mystery #1 Cain eventually confessed that he had been lurking inside the House all along, and Elvira went on to host horror stories elsewhere.Elvira's House of Mystery #11 Shortly later, Morpheus, the Lord of the Dreaming, returned to his domain after over a century in jail and staggered to the House of Mystery's door, where Cain and Abel nursed him to health. Following Morpheus' return, the House focused mostly on the Dreaming, where Cain frequently entertained other supernatural storytellers.Sandman (Volume 2) #2 More recently, the House has vanished from its usual location(s) and transformed into a coaching inn in an extradimensional realm; Cain spent several months searching for it. John Constantine won the House in a card game, but when the Justice League Dark battled Blight, he lost it to Zatanna. The House eventually called on John Constantine to return to the land, and he restored control. Second tab content goes here. Note: This article is protected. Irrelevant The House of Mystery's origins are unknown, yet it appears to exist simultaneously in both The Dreaming and Earth, near to a graveyard. The House appears to be sentient and serves as a repository for stories, usually extremely awful ones. Cain has cared after the House for endless years, much as his brother Abel looks for the House of Secrets. Cain went absent briefly a few years ago, and the House nominated Elvira as its new caretaker until he returned; the House appears to require a caretaker, despite the fact that it is perfectly capable of looking after itself, and indeed of totally rebuilding itself at will.Elvira's House of Mystery #1 Cain eventually confessed that he had been lurking inside the House all along, and Elvira went on to host horror stories elsewhere.Elvira's House of Mystery #11 Shortly later, Morpheus, the Lord of the Dreaming, returned to his domain after over a century in jail and staggered to the House of Mystery's door, where Cain and Abel nursed him to health. Following Morpheus' return, the House focused mostly on the Dreaming, where Cain frequently entertained other supernatural storytellers.Sandman (Volume 2) #2 More recently, the House has vanished from its usual location(s) and transformed into a coaching inn in an extradimensional realm; Cain spent several months searching for it. sources.origin: 420px|right |-|Modern=420px|right ==Summary== Doomsday was created on prehistoric Krypton thousands of years ago by a scientist named Bertron as a bio-mechanical super-soldier and living weapon of mass destruction. This process involved Bertron cross-breeding the artificial birth of a Kryptonian hybrid, left to fend for itself in the harshest environments of the Kryptonian wilderness with the creature killed and its genetic material collected to create a more resilient clone. This process, along with further cross-breeding with the DNA of the strongest creatures on Krypton, was repeated over and over for decades as a form of accelerated natural evolution. The agony of these repeated deaths was recorded in the genes of Bertron's final creation, driving the creature insane and following one overwhelming instinct: destroy everyone and everything in sight. When the creature proved too difficult to control, the Council discontinued Bertron's experiments and banned all forms of cross-breeding while having the creature jettisoned into the Phantom Zone. However, the beast acted in his final moments of consciousness to change the stasis cell's trajectory and it eventually crashed on Earth, the force of the impact driving it deep underground. The beast slept for centuries before finally reviving and bursting free. Dubbed "Doomsday" by Booster Gold, the beast is still motivated by his instincts to kill everything around him yet has a greater obsession to kill all Kryptonians. ==Powers and Stats

This can cause spontaneous burning and victims to fall into comas), Corruption/Biological Manipulation (Can imprint his genetic code onto others through mere contact), Spatial Manipulation and Void Manipulation (Broke through the dimensional barrier of the Phantom Zone through sheer power. The Phantom Zone is described as "a world of boundless twilight, a stopping place between being and nothingness...a dimension without dimensions...without horizons"), Resistance to the following: Mind Manipulation, Telepathy, Soul Manipulation, Energy Attacks, Biological Manipulation, Immense Heat (Can tank Superman's Heat Vision), Ultrasonic Attacks, Matter Manipulation, Existence Erasure, BFR (Withstood Darkseid's Omega Beams), ect.

Multiverse level+ normally (Portrayed as being comparable to Superman, who in his clash against Jaxon the Mighty generated enough energy to counter the combined power of the future Green Lantern Corps, which destroyed multiple timelines. Superior to the likes of Wonder Woman, who restrained Firstborn, a monstrous being capable of destroying all of the underworld - an infinite plane of reality and Wonder Woman destroyed the Chronus Scepter, which contains the power of the Godwave that surrounds the multiverse.), Outerverse level at his peak (Doomsday defeated True Form Darkseid, which was confirmed by writers of DC Comics. Darkseid was ending all of existence during one of his fights where he defeated Highfather. Darkseid, being a New God, should be an incredibly powerful, living idea from a kind of Platonic, archetypal world. New Gods exist within the Sphere of the Gods, The Sphere of the Gods is consistently beyond the concepts of space and time. Within the Sphere of the Gods, there are infinite limbos, and infinite heavens and hell. Doomsday have also broken The Phantom Zone. The Phantom Zone is described as a boundless dimensionless dimension between being and nothingness and it resides within the Sphere of the Gods, described multiple times as a Platonic, archetypal world, beyond the Bleed, which contains all dimensions, in which there are an infinite number of. The Phantom Zone exists at the same level as New Genesis, which is beyond the bounds of space and time.)

Immeasurable normally, Irrelevant at his peak (Can keep up with the likes of Superman, who flew into Hyperspace, which is a realm that exists beyond space and time, who flew back in time through the timestream until he flew through a timeless, placeless dimension, Superman flew out of the Source after Highfather said that it would be impossible to do.)

Multiverse level+ normally, Outerverse level at his peak (Has took attacks and hits from the likes of Superman, Green Lantern, Wonder Woman without damage. Took Darkseid's True Form Omega beams, which could damage The Spectre.)

Multiverse level+ normally (Portrayed as being comparable to Superman, who in his clash against Jaxon the Mighty generated enough energy to counter the combined power of the future Green Lantern Corps, which destroyed multiple timelines. Darkseid was ending all of existence during one of his fights where he defeated Highfather. Darkseid, being a New God, should be an incredibly powerful, living idea from a kind of Platonic, archetypal world. New Gods exist within the Sphere of the Gods, The Sphere of the Gods is consistently beyond the concepts of space and time. Within the Sphere of the Gods, there are infinite limbos, and infinite heavens and hell. Doomsday have also broken The Phantom Zone. The Phantom Zone is described as a boundless dimensionless dimension between being and nothingness and it resides within the Sphere of the Gods, described multiple times as a Platonic, archetypal world, beyond the Bleed, which contains all dimensions, in which there are an infinite number of. The Phantom Zone exists at the same level as New Genesis, which is beyond the bounds of space and time.)

Immeasurable normally, Irrelevant at his peak (Can keep up with the likes of Superman, who flew into Hyperspace, which is a realm that exists beyond space and time, who flew back in time through the timestream until he flew through a timeless, placeless dimension, Superman flew out of the Source after Highfather said that it would be impossible to do.)

Gifted (A veteran with years of combat and living experience, clever when he comes up with the creation World Engine with information from an ancient Kryptonian outpost. As the commanding General of Krypton's military, it is expected for him to be well-versed in strategy and tactics, a charismatic leader and an adaptive combatant. An expert at close-quarters combat and, in his fight with Kal-El, mastered abilities that took Kal years to fully control within only a few hours and minutes)

Becomes as vulnerable as a human when exposed to either red suns or environments under their effect. Devoted to his duty and "his people" (Kryptonian bloodlines deemed by him to be strong) above all else. Initially upon his arrival to the Earth, sensory overloads would occur if he did not have his protective visor on, however this problem was later dealt with as Zod adapted to Earth's yellow sun environment Notable Attacks/Techniques: *Anti-Gravity Field Creation: It is unknown how Zod did this. Upon releasing himself from his Battle Armor and levitating, the armor floated around him in the air for many centimeters, however this ability does not seem to be useful for battle. *Solar Energy Absorption: As a native Kryptonian, Zod's cells can absorb yellow solar energy which fuels all of his powers and abilities. *Heat Vision: The ability to fire beams of intense heat at a target by looking at it with the conscious act of activating this power. Visually, the power is typically depicted as two beams of red light firing from his eyes. Zod can use his heat vision to split a skyscraper hundreds of stories tall in half and cause it to collapse. *X-Ray Vision: The ability to see through most materials save for lead. ==Notable Matchups== Victories: Losses: * Kishou Arima (Tokyo Ghoul) Arima's Profile (Both were restricted to 7-C Scaling) Inconclusive: ==References== Category:Characters Category:Movie Characters Category:Primary Antagonists Category:Antagonists Category:Evil Characters Category:Energy Users Category:Kryptonians Category:Male Characters Category:Military Characters Category:Gun Users Category:Knife Users Category:Leaders Category:Revolutionaries Category:Criminals Category:Flight Users Category:Live-Action Characters Category:Aliens Category:Solar Energy Users Category:Regeneration Users Category:DC Extended Universe Category:Fallen Characters Category:Temperature Users Category:Villains Category:Misanthropes Category:Tragic Characters Category:Supervillains Category:Armor Users Category:Traitors Category:Warlords Category:Prisoners Category:Terrorists Category:Martial Artists Category:Pilots Category:Brawlers Category:Soldiers Category:Humanoid Characters Category:War Criminals

Respect Threads: Amino Apps, Deviantart 1, Deviantart 2 Note: Before making any changes to this page, please read and follow the Power-scaling Rules for Marvel and DC Comics. ==Notable Matchups== Victories: Losses: Inconclusive: {{discussions|Gorilla Gross Post-Crisis|Gorilla Grodd (Post-Crisis)}} Category:DC Comics Category:Comic Book Characters Category:Villains Category:Animals Category:Telepaths Category:Telekinesis Users Category:Possession Users Category:Illusionists Category:Matter Users Category:Geniuses Category:Characters Category:Primary Antagonists Category:Male Characters Category:Evil Characters Category:Parents Category:Primates Category:Mind Users Category:Forcefield Users Category:Gun Users Category:Durability Negation Users Category:Bodily Weaponry Users Category:Energy Projection Users Category:Absorption Users Category:Animal Users Category:Preparation Users Category:Secret Society Members Category:Spoon Users Category:Helmet Users Category:Mammals
At least 9-A physically, up to 7-B with Preparation

* Superhuman Physical Characteristics (See Attack Potency, Speed, Lifting Strength, and Durability) *Genius Intelligence (See Intelligence) *Enhanced Senses (Gorillas have senses of hearing and smell a bit beyond that of humans) *Mind Manipulation (Over the course of the DCAU, his mental powers develop: as of Justice League, he can force his targets to do his bidding and force their dormant emotions to emerge. He can also produce devastating mental attacks that cause the affected to experience excruciating, mind-breaking pain - these attacks can even disrupt the focus of Green Lantern. As of Justice League Unlimited, he can place mental blocks in his allies' brains that cause their brains to shut down (resulting in either incapacitation, as with Giganta, or death as with Metallo) if they reveal his secrets or even if his secrets are revealed through his ally's mind being probed - these psychic aftershocks are potent enough to cause a telepath on Martian Manhunter's level to double over in pain just from reading Giganta's mind while it was being shut down) *Superhuman Athleticism (Performed a superhuman leap over Hawkgirl) *Hand-to-Hand Combat Skills (Demonstrates an acrobatic fighting style while beating down Lex Luthor) *Acrobatics (Can do flips during combat) *Stealth Mastery (Hid from the Flash and got the drop on him) *Preparation (During Secret Society, devised methods of surveilling the Justice League for a long time in order to best disrupt their team synergy and leave them vulnerable to attack and staged an ambush against the Justice League where he lured them to their own training camp under false pretenses and rewired it to attack them. Acquired nuclear missiles to destroy Gorilla City during Brave and the Bold, and went out of his way to deactivate the city's shield) *Social Influencing (Charisma: Manipulated Sara Corwin into becoming his devoted accomplice as of some point before Brave and the Bold, and manipulated much of the Legion of Doom, including Weather Wizard and Parasite, into being loyal to him) With Preparation, Grodd can utilize: *Flight (Used a Gorilla City speeder vehicle) *Energy Projection (with various energy blasters) *Explosion Manipulation (Acquired nuclear missiles to destroy Gorilla City and gave his minion an energy blaster that caused explosions with its blast) *Radiation Manipulation (The explosion of his Nuclear Missiles would produce tremendous radioactivity) *Biological Manipulation (During Dead Reckoning, invented a device that rewrote DNA and turned all humans into apes) *Forcefield Creation (Erected a forcefield around his generator)

At least Small Building Level physically (Upscaling from 0.095 Tons - Struggled evenly with Hawkgirl and made her yell in pain with a kick - albeit her durability is somewhat inconsistent. Completely embarrassed Base-Form Lex Luthor in a fistfight and threatened to snap his neck - this same Luthor being capable of ripping apart machinery and computer panels with raw strength. Knocked out The Flash with a punch, but the Flash himself has inconsistent durability. One-shot Solovar, who could break a parking gate in two with one blow. Punched through a computer panel), up to City Level with Preparation (Acquired nuclear missiles that would have destroyed Gorilla City, as seen in "The Brave and the Bold: Part 2") - one of Grodd's blasters could harm Sinestro through his energy barrier, but in that same episode its blasts only crack a TV screen (which we know for a fact Sinestro scales above) and practically bounces off of Luthor's gauntlets - this may be an example of Attack Potency trumping Destructive Capacity, but it's certainly debatable and could easily be interpreted as this weapon simply being too inconsistent to rate.

Relativistic+ reactions and combat speed (Scaling to 0.53c - Flipped behind Hawkgirl, avoiding her mace swing, and kicked her quicker than she could turn around - and immediately afterward he reacted to her charge and mental-attacked her before she could complete an attack. Leapt onto Martian Manhunter too quickly for him to get out of the way. Blitzed Solovar from across a room (dodging an energy blast from an energy gun in the process), with Solovar being capable of dodging bullets), and Hypersonic+ attack speed with ICBMs (ICBMs make contact at a speed of about 7km/s, or about Mach 20)

At least Small Building Level (Upscaling from 0.095 Tons - Should compare to his physical strength. Should be at least as durable as Amanda Waller (who tanked a portion of this explosion) and a 13-year-old Tim Drake. Survived the vacuum of space, as he reappears in JL Infinity), possibly higher (Has taken attacks from Justice Leaguers such as Wonder Woman, Hawkgirl, and Superman, but all of these leaguers were most likely holding back as to not kill him, considering he is just barely above peak human level in the context of the verse - Superman's attack in this instance was literally flicking Grodd with his finger, implying Grodd isn't much of a physical threat to any of the League besides Batman and a Mace-Less Hawkgirl. Survived being crushed in Giganta's hands, but it's also quite strongly implied she's trying to torture him with constant pain rather than give him a quick death, and as such has reason to hold back. intelligence.text: Genius (Ollie was remembered as history's greatest archer by the year 3000.Adventure Comics Vol 1 251 Consistently shown to be growing in skill, to the point where a rusty or tired Ollie easily performed feats superior to nearly any other archer. His skill is only truly rivaled by Merlyn the Dark Archer and Arsenal, and was said to be an even better marksman than Deadshot, who had perfect aim.Deadshot Vol 2 2 Beyond just being an impeccable shot, Ollie has extensive knowledge of human biologyLong Bow Hunters Vol 1 1Green Arrow Vol 2 2Green Arrow Vol 3 15The Question Vol 1 17The Brave and the Bold Vol 2 21Green Arrow Vol 2 22 and the construction of vehicles, which he often uses in battle. His resourcefulness in combat has additionally allows him to use the environment itself as a key asset.Green Arrow Vol 2 7 In addition to his archery, Ollie is shown to be one of the worlds' best combatants, capable of outsmarting Deathstroke and the League of Assassins on numerous occasions. Knowing his limits, the Emerald Archer frequently trains with Wildcat,Identity Crisis Vol 1 1 the Justice League,Identity Crisis Vol 1 3 and for a year straight, the greatest teachers in the world to vastly improve his abilities ) Genius (Ollie is an expert hunter with a deep knowledge of survival and tracking. He has learned to study the subtle movements of prey animals to a tee and can tell the obscure differences between footprints. *Superhuman Physical Characteristics (See Attack Potency, Speed, and Durability) *Weapon Mastery (Demonstrates profound mastery of the bow and arrow, with his feats of marksmanship including shooting an arrow into the barrel of a gun from a distance, hitting Brimstone's reactor from a distance, etc) *Hand-to-Hand Combat Expertise (Demonstrates aptitude for combat, particularly boxing - with Black Canary considering his level of skill somewhat notable (though lesser than her own) and GA being capable of defeating The Question) *Stealth Mastery (Has demonstrated the capacity to sneak up on enemies with great expertise) *Acrobatics (Frequently does flips and rolls to recover from or avoid attacks) *Explosion Manipulation (with Explosive Arrows and his Quantum Arrow) *Electricity Manipulation (with Taser Arrows) *Paralysis Inducement (with Net Arrows and Bola Arrows) *Smoke Manipulation (with Smoke Arrows) *Sleep Manipulation (with his Knockout Gas Arrow)

Small Building Level physically (Downscaling from 0.095 Tons - Beat up the Question, who (during JLU Season 2) was all but stated to be capable of physically subduing a non-enhanced Lex Luthor for long enough to strangle him to death with a tie, with the Brainiac-Induced super strength Lex had at the time being strongly implied to be the only reason Vic's plan didn't work. As a well-built grown man with ample martial arts training and enough superhero experience to have had a sidekick, it stands to reason GA would be stronger than Rocky Ballentine (a relatively normal woman whose only training was a women's self-defense course), who could contend with and harm Jay and Lark - the latter two being capable of kicking someone through a wall. He should also be stronger than borderline-civilian Kathy Duquesne, who destroyed a wooden crate with one kick. Can casually knock grown men out in one hit), higher with Impact Arrows (Could injure the Huntress, and were implied to be possibly helpful against Wildcat. Ripped through Dark Heart drones, which were unhurt by machine gun fire. Oneshot a Parademon), at least Small Building Level, possibly higher with Explosive Arrows (Has created massive explosions, with one being capable of destroying a military-grade helicopter), far higher with Quantum Arrow (Created an explosion this size)

Hypersonic (Scaling to Mach 8.7), possibly Relativistic+ (Scaling to 0.53c) reactions and combat speed (Dodged a strike from and leg-swept Mano, who could keep up with and land hits on Batman, and moved in tandem with a Lantern beam at close range, blocking it with his hand. Believed he could release his bowstring to fire arrows quicker than Huntress (who could dodge attacks from a bloodlusted Wonder Woman and keep up with Roulette, who side-stepped a sound wave at close range) could move. Avoided gunfire and attacks from Brimstone), with his arrows possessing Subsonic+ attack speed (Considering his superhuman (by IRL standards) strength and how advanced his equipment is, it's not unreasonable to assume his arrows travel at speeds meeting or exceeding the World Record of 550 mph)

Small Building Level (Downscaling from 0.095 Tons - Should scale to his AP as per Newton's Third Law. Got up immediately, only being scuffed from dirt, after being a few meters away from the explosion of his and Speedy's quantum arrows - however, exactly how much force he took in this instance is difficult to determine. Kept fighting after blows from an angry Wildcat, who could allegedly fight evenly with Black Canary, defeat Tracer (as evidenced by being the Meta-Brawl's champion - Tracer being capable of tackling Batman and hurting him with a punch), and destroy a wall with one hit)

Normal Human Weaknesses. Ergo, I only consider those three comics canon. Category:Goulden1998 Category:Tier 9

His skill is only truly rivaled by Merlyn the Dark Archer and Arsenal, and was said to be an even better marksman than Deadshot, who had perfect aim.Deadshot Vol 2 2 Beyond just being an impeccable shot, Ollie has extensive knowledge of human biologyLong Bow Hunters Vol 1 1Green Arrow Vol 2 2Green Arrow Vol 3 15The Question Vol 1 17The Brave and the Bold Vol 2 21Green Arrow Vol 2 22 and the construction of vehicles, which he often uses in battle. His resourcefulness in combat has additionally allows him to use the environment itself as a key asset.Green Arrow Vol 2 7 In addition to his archery, Ollie is shown to be one of the worlds' best combatants, capable of outsmarting Deathstroke and the League of Assassins on numerous occasions. Knowing his limits, the Emerald Archer frequently trains with Wildcat,Identity Crisis Vol 1 1 the Justice League,Identity Crisis Vol 1 3 and for a year straight, the greatest teachers in the world to vastly improve his abilities ) Genius (Ollie is an expert hunter with a deep knowledge of survival and tracking. He has learned to study the subtle movements of prey animals to a tee and can tell the obscure differences between footprints. Memorized very square inch of the Star City Forest, in all of its confusing glory,Green Arrow Vol 4 1 Skilled at bandaging wounds.Green Arrow Vol 2 4) Gifted (Ollie proved himself to be a skilled politician in his run as mayor of Star City, gaining a high approval rate and flawlessly executing complicated legal procedures to punish his opponents) Standard Tactics: Although traditionally a long-ranged fighter, Ollie is by no means a one-trick pony. An expert acrobatic, Ollie consistently uses his agility and nimbleness to overwhelm his enemies, a tactic that even worked on highly skilled combatants such as Roy Harper and Deathstroke. Unlike many DC heroes, Ollie is willing to kill under extreme circumstances, admitting that he doesn't have a reason to keep sparing Merlyn's life and killed several terrorists with explosives. He is, however, still a merciful and compassionate man who will spare the lives of most of his enemies, and has even shown a great deal of compassion towards Solomon Grundy.

Small Building Level physically (Downscaling from 0.095 Tons - Beat up the Question, who (during JLU Season 2) was all but stated to be capable of physically subduing a non-enhanced Lex Luthor for long enough to strangle him to death with a tie, with the Brainiac-Induced super strength Lex had at the time being strongly implied to be the only reason Vic's plan didn't work. As a well-built grown man with ample martial arts training and enough superhero experience to have had a sidekick, it stands to reason GA would be stronger than Rocky Ballentine (a relatively normal woman whose only training was a women's self-defense course), who could contend with and harm Jay and Lark - the latter two being capable of kicking someone through a wall. He should also be stronger than borderline-civilian Kathy Duquesne, who destroyed a wooden crate with one kick. Can casually knock grown men out in one hit), higher with Impact Arrows (Could injure the Huntress, and were implied to be possibly helpful against Wildcat. Ripped through Dark Heart drones, which were unhurt by machine gun fire. Oneshot a Parademon), at least Small Building Level, possibly higher with Explosive Arrows (Has created massive explosions, with one being capable of destroying a military-grade helicopter), far higher with Quantum Arrow (Created an explosion this size)

Hypersonic (Scaling to Mach 8.7), possibly Relativistic+ (Scaling to 0.53c) reactions and combat speed (Dodged a strike from and leg-swept Mano, who could keep up with and land hits on Batman, and moved in tandem with a Lantern beam at close range, blocking it with his hand. Believed he could release his bowstring to fire arrows quicker than Huntress (who could dodge attacks from a bloodlusted Wonder Woman and keep up with Roulette, who side-stepped a sound wave at close range) could move. Avoided gunfire and attacks from Brimstone), with his arrows possessing Subsonic+ attack speed (Considering his superhuman (by IRL standards) strength and how advanced his equipment is, it's not unreasonable to assume his arrows travel at speeds meeting or exceeding the World Record of 550 mph)

Small Building Level (Downscaling from 0.095 Tons - Should scale to his AP as per Newton's Third Law. Got up immediately, only being scuffed from dirt, after being a few meters away from the explosion of his and Speedy's quantum arrows - however, exactly how much force he took in this instance is difficult to determine. Kept fighting after blows from an angry Wildcat, who could allegedly fight evenly with Black Canary, defeat Tracer (as evidenced by being the Meta-Brawl's champion - Tracer being capable of tackling Batman and hurting him with a punch), and destroy a wall with one hit)

Normal Human Weaknesses. Note: Bruce Timm has stated that the original DCAU tie-in comics are not canon, with the only tie in comics that have statements to the contrary (other than Batman: The Adventures Continue, which has so many continuity issues that it's essentially impossible to argue it's canon) being Justice League Infinity, the Batman and Harley Quinn tie in comics, and specifically the first annual of Batman Adventures. Ergo, I only consider those three comics canon. Category:Goulden1998 Category:Tier 9

His resourcefulness in combat has additionally allows him to use the environment itself as a key asset.Green Arrow Vol 2 7 In addition to his archery, Ollie is shown to be one of the worlds' best combatants, capable of outsmarting Deathstroke and the League of Assassins on numerous occasions. Knowing his limits, the Emerald Archer frequently trains with Wildcat,Identity Crisis Vol 1 1 the Justice League,Identity Crisis Vol 1 3 and for a year straight, the greatest teachers in the world to vastly improve his abilities ) Genius (Ollie is an expert hunter with a deep knowledge of survival and tracking. He has learned to study the subtle movements of prey animals to a tee and can tell the obscure differences between footprints. Memorized very square inch of the Star City Forest, in all of its confusing glory,Green Arrow Vol 4 1 Skilled at bandaging wounds.Green Arrow Vol 2 4) Gifted (Ollie proved himself to be a skilled politician in his run as mayor of Star City, gaining a high approval rate and flawlessly executing complicated legal procedures to punish his opponents) Standard Tactics: Although traditionally a long-ranged fighter, Ollie is by no means a one-trick pony. An expert acrobatic, Ollie consistently uses his agility and nimbleness to overwhelm his enemies, a tactic that even worked on highly skilled combatants such as Roy Harper and Deathstroke. Unlike many DC heroes, Ollie is willing to kill under extreme circumstances, admitting that he doesn't have a reason to keep sparing Merlyn's life and killed several terrorists with explosives. He is, however, still a merciful and compassionate man who will spare the lives of most of his enemies, and has even shown a great deal of compassion towards Solomon Grundy.

Ollie is easily seduced by women, even cheating on his lover Black Canary, whom he loves dearly, without hesitation. He is also inherently sympathetic to marginalized groups, which while this is usually a strength that allows him to gain allies, has been used to manipulate him in the past. ==Notable Matchups== Victories: Losses: Inconclusive: ==References== : References in bold are Pre-Crisis showings.
