These are powers or abilities that are commonly displayed amongst members of the Green Lantern Corps in order for them to combat their enemies effectively, though do keep in mind not every member shares the same hax these are just the ones that are inherent byproducts of being a member of the Green Lantern Corps...Willpower Manipulation, Emotional Manipulation, Energy Manipulation via Emotional Energy Manipulation (Members of the Green Lantern Corps harness the power of willpower from the Emotional Energy Spectrum in order to fuel their ringsGreen Lantern: Rebirth #3 (February, 2005), it's also stated hereGreen Lantern Vol 5 #21 (August, 2013)), Indomitable Will, Flight, Creation (By using their imaginations members of the Green Lantern Corps can create constructs using their rings, Two-Six states this to be an akin to an equation with an infinite amount of possible outcomes), Telepathy (Members of The Green Lantern Corps can communicate with other members via telepathic sub-channels),

(Team Wide) Universal+ Destructive Capacity via Green Lantern Ring (Any Lantern whom uses a power ring is continuously draining the finite emotional spectrum of their universe which upon emptying ultimately results in the complete destruction of the universe itself, this is stated on multiple occasions) ==Standard Member Paraphernalia== Depending on the skill and willpower of the wearer, it can do almost anything. The first Green Lantern Ring on Earth in modern times was crafted and worn by Alan Scott and powered by the mystical Starheart. His proved to be the exception, the by-product of the efforts of the Guardians of the Universe to contain the magic of the universe. The Guardians also created the more widespread version, powered by individual Green Lantern Power Batteries through a connection to the Central Power Battery on Oa. With the exception of the ring worn by Alan Scott, the current rings are based on the one given to Kyle Rayner when he was the only Green Lantern in existence. All power rings need periodic recharging. The process is not instantaneous so many Green Lanterns recite an oath while the ring charges. The oath is not required to charge the ring, but is recited to reaffirm the person's commitment to the Green Lantern Corps, and to measure the time it takes the ring to charge. While many Green Lanterns create their own oath, the majority use the Corps' official oath as a sign of respect. In the interests of political correctness on the part of DC (or, in context, Hal Jordan), the word "blackest" was replaced by "darkest"; this practice has been abandoned with the reinstating of the Green Lantern Corps due in part to the significance of the Blackest Night comic event. Particularily alien Green Lanterns may have modified oaths. For example, Rot Lop Fan, a Green Lantern from a starless sector, replaces light with sound in his oath. The Central Power Battery is the reservoir of power for the emotional spectrum of willpower, and channels the energy used to empower the Green Lantern Corps. All of the green energy housed within a Green Lantern ring comes from a smaller battery, which in turn, functions as a conduit to the Central Power Battery on Oa. It was built billions of years ago, when the highly evolved Maltusians (now known as the Guardians of the Universe) united their powerful minds to create a green crystal - green because it was a mixture of their blue mental energy and a yellow impurity "necessary to fix its form." They grew the crystal and carved it into the shape of a giant battery, and from the same crystal carved smaller batteries and power rings. The Central Power Battery has been destroyed and rebuilt several times. It was first destroyed several years ago by the forces of Krona. Unfortunately, the battery exploded during an assemblage of all 3,600 members of the Green Lantern Corps, several of whom were killed instantly. The surviving members struggled valiantly to put out the rampaging inferno of green energy that swept across the Oan Citadel. The next cataclysmic event occurred after Sinestro's execution, which resulted in the renegade being imprisoned inside the battery. The energy of the Green Lanterns' power source started to drain their rings, stripping most of them of their power. In the end, it took the combined efforts of Hal Jordan and Appa Ali Apsa to stop the battery from exploding and creating a black hole. However, the damage caused to the battery rendered the Green Lantern Corps almost useless, with only a few Green Lanterns with active power rings scattered throughout the universe.

These are powers or abilities that are commonly displayed amongst members of the Green Lantern Corps in order for them to combat their enemies effectively, though do keep in mind not every member shares the same hax these are just the ones that are inherent byproducts of being a member of the Green Lantern Corps...Willpower Manipulation, Emotional Manipulation, Energy Manipulation via Emotional Energy Manipulation (Members of the Green Lantern Corps harness the power of willpower from the Emotional Energy Spectrum in order to fuel their ringsGreen Lantern: Rebirth #3 (February, 2005), it's also stated hereGreen Lantern Vol 5 #21 (August, 2013)), Indomitable Will, Flight, Creation (By using their imaginations members of the Green Lantern Corps can create constructs using their rings, Two-Six states this to be an akin to an equation with an infinite amount of possible outcomes), Telepathy (Members of The Green Lantern Corps can communicate with other members via telepathic sub-channels),

(Team Wide) Universal+ Destructive Capacity via Green Lantern Ring (Any Lantern whom uses a power ring is continuously draining the finite emotional spectrum of their universe which upon emptying ultimately results in the complete destruction of the universe itself, this is stated on multiple occasions) ==Standard Member Paraphernalia== Depending on the skill and willpower of the wearer, it can do almost anything. The first Green Lantern Ring on Earth in modern times was crafted and worn by Alan Scott and powered by the mystical Starheart. His proved to be the exception, the by-product of the efforts of the Guardians of the Universe to contain the magic of the universe. The Guardians also created the more widespread version, powered by individual Green Lantern Power Batteries through a connection to the Central Power Battery on Oa. With the exception of the ring worn by Alan Scott, the current rings are based on the one given to Kyle Rayner when he was the only Green Lantern in existence. All power rings need periodic recharging. The process is not instantaneous so many Green Lanterns recite an oath while the ring charges. The oath is not required to charge the ring, but is recited to reaffirm the person's commitment to the Green Lantern Corps, and to measure the time it takes the ring to charge. While many Green Lanterns create their own oath, the majority use the Corps' official oath as a sign of respect. In the interests of political correctness on the part of DC (or, in context, Hal Jordan), the word "blackest" was replaced by "darkest"; this practice has been abandoned with the reinstating of the Green Lantern Corps due in part to the significance of the Blackest Night comic event. Particularily alien Green Lanterns may have modified oaths. For example, Rot Lop Fan, a Green Lantern from a starless sector, replaces light with sound in his oath. The Central Power Battery is the reservoir of power for the emotional spectrum of willpower, and channels the energy used to empower the Green Lantern Corps. All of the green energy housed within a Green Lantern ring comes from a smaller battery, which in turn, functions as a conduit to the Central Power Battery on Oa. It was built billions of years ago, when the highly evolved Maltusians (now known as the Guardians of the Universe) united their powerful minds to create a green crystal - green because it was a mixture of their blue mental energy and a yellow impurity "necessary to fix its form." They grew the crystal and carved it into the shape of a giant battery, and from the same crystal carved smaller batteries and power rings. The Central Power Battery has been destroyed and rebuilt several times. It was first destroyed several years ago by the forces of Krona. Unfortunately, the battery exploded during an assemblage of all 3,600 members of the Green Lantern Corps, several of whom were killed instantly. The surviving members struggled valiantly to put out the rampaging inferno of green energy that swept across the Oan Citadel. The next cataclysmic event occurred after Sinestro's execution, which resulted in the renegade being imprisoned inside the battery. The energy of the Green Lanterns' power source started to drain their rings, stripping most of them of their power. In the end, it took the combined efforts of Hal Jordan and Appa Ali Apsa to stop the battery from exploding and creating a black hole. However, the damage caused to the battery rendered the Green Lantern Corps almost useless, with only a few Green Lanterns with active power rings scattered throughout the universe.

These are powers or abilities that are commonly displayed amongst members of the Green Lantern Corps in order for them to combat their enemies effectively, though do keep in mind not every member shares the same hax these are just the ones that are inherent byproducts of being a member of the Green Lantern Corps...Willpower Manipulation, Emotional Manipulation, Energy Manipulation via Emotional Energy Manipulation (Members of the Green Lantern Corps harness the power of willpower from the Emotional Energy Spectrum in order to fuel their ringsGreen Lantern: Rebirth #3 (February, 2005), it's also stated hereGreen Lantern Vol 5 #21 (August, 2013)), Indomitable Will, Flight, Creation (By using their imaginations members of the Green Lantern Corps can create constructs using their rings, Two-Six states this to be an akin to an equation with an infinite amount of possible outcomes), Telepathy (Members of The Green Lantern Corps can communicate with other members via telepathic sub-channels),

(Team Wide) Universal+ Destructive Capacity via Green Lantern Ring (Any Lantern whom uses a power ring is continuously draining the finite emotional spectrum of their universe which upon emptying ultimately results in the complete destruction of the universe itself, this is stated on multiple occasions) ==Standard Member Paraphernalia== Depending on the skill and willpower of the wearer, it can do almost anything. The first Green Lantern Ring on Earth in modern times was crafted and worn by Alan Scott and powered by the mystical Starheart. His proved to be the exception, the by-product of the efforts of the Guardians of the Universe to contain the magic of the universe. The Guardians also created the more widespread version, powered by individual Green Lantern Power Batteries through a connection to the Central Power Battery on Oa. With the exception of the ring worn by Alan Scott, the current rings are based on the one given to Kyle Rayner when he was the only Green Lantern in existence. All power rings need periodic recharging. The process is not instantaneous so many Green Lanterns recite an oath while the ring charges. The oath is not required to charge the ring, but is recited to reaffirm the person's commitment to the Green Lantern Corps, and to measure the time it takes the ring to charge. While many Green Lanterns create their own oath, the majority use the Corps' official oath as a sign of respect. In the interests of political correctness on the part of DC (or, in context, Hal Jordan), the word "blackest" was replaced by "darkest"; this practice has been abandoned with the reinstating of the Green Lantern Corps due in part to the significance of the Blackest Night comic event. Particularily alien Green Lanterns may have modified oaths. For example, Rot Lop Fan, a Green Lantern from a starless sector, replaces light with sound in his oath. The Central Power Battery is the reservoir of power for the emotional spectrum of willpower, and channels the energy used to empower the Green Lantern Corps. All of the green energy housed within a Green Lantern ring comes from a smaller battery, which in turn, functions as a conduit to the Central Power Battery on Oa. It was built billions of years ago, when the highly evolved Maltusians (now known as the Guardians of the Universe) united their powerful minds to create a green crystal - green because it was a mixture of their blue mental energy and a yellow impurity "necessary to fix its form." They grew the crystal and carved it into the shape of a giant battery, and from the same crystal carved smaller batteries and power rings. The Central Power Battery has been destroyed and rebuilt several times. It was first destroyed several years ago by the forces of Krona. Unfortunately, the battery exploded during an assemblage of all 3,600 members of the Green Lantern Corps, several of whom were killed instantly. The surviving members struggled valiantly to put out the rampaging inferno of green energy that swept across the Oan Citadel. The next cataclysmic event occurred after Sinestro's execution, which resulted in the renegade being imprisoned inside the battery. The energy of the Green Lanterns' power source started to drain their rings, stripping most of them of their power. In the end, it took the combined efforts of Hal Jordan and Appa Ali Apsa to stop the battery from exploding and creating a black hole. However, the damage caused to the battery rendered the Green Lantern Corps almost useless, with only a few Green Lanterns with active power rings scattered throughout the universe.

It holds the distinction of exerting the least influence on its wielder and can only be mastered by individuals with an indomitable will capable of overcoming great fear. The embodiment of this emotion is Ion. The Maltusians initially harnessed this energy, which later passed on to the Oans, male Maltusians who aspired to establish order in the universe. After the Controllers departed, those remaining on Oa evolved into the Guardians of the Universe.
